text.text: HX Mini
Front View
Cisco 6324 FI

The UCS Mini extends the Cisco UCS architecture into environments with requirements for smaller domains. Providing the same unified server and networking capabilities as the top-of-rack 6200 Series Fabric Interconnect, the 6324 Fabric Interconnect embeds the connectivity within the Cisco UCS 5108 Blade Server Chassis to provide a smaller domain of up to 15 servers (eight blade servers and up to seven direct-connect rack servers).

text.text: UCS B200 M4

The UCS B200 M4 is built with the Intel ® Xeon ® E5-2600 v3 processor family, up to 768 GB of memory (with 32 GB DIMMs), up to two drives, and up to 80 Gbps total bandwidth. It offers exceptional levels of performance, flexibility, and I/O throughput to run the most demanding applications.Optimized for data center or cloud, the Cisco UCS B200 M4 can quickly deploy stateless physical and virtual workloads, with the programmability of the UCS Manager and simplified server access of SingleConnect technology. The UCS C240 M3 rack server is designed for both performance and expandability over a wide range of storage-intensive infrastructure workloads from big data to collaboration. The enterprise-class UCS C240 M3 server further extends the capabilities of the Cisco ® UCS TM portfolio in a 2U form factor with the addition of the Intel ® Xeon ® processor E5-2600 v2 product family that delivers the best combination of performance, flexibility and efficiency gains. The UCS C240 M3 server offers up to 768 GB of RAM, 24 drives and 4 x 1 GbE LOM to provide outstanding levels of internal memory and storage expandability along with exceptional performance.

text.text: The UCS C220 M3 rack mount server is designed for performance and density over a wide range of business workloads from web serving to distributed database. The enterprise-class UCS C220 M3 Server further extends the capabilities of Cisco’s UCS TM portfolio in a 1U form factor with the addition of the Intel ® Xeon ® processor E5-2600 v2 product family that delivers significant performance and efficiency gains. In addition, the UCS C220 M3 server offers up to 256 GB of RAM (using 16 GB DIMMs), 8 drives and 2 x 1 GbE LOM ports delivering outstanding levels of density and performance in a compact package.
